text: Front fog lamps submitted for approval shall clearly, legibly and indelibly bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
Front fog lamps submitted for approval shall clearly, legibly and indelibly bear a marking indicating the class of the front fog lamp.
Class F3 front fog lamps submitted for approval shall clearly, legibly and indelibly bear the LED module specific identification code, if any.
condition: if the lamp is fitted with LED module(s)

text: Front fog lamps shall comprise, on the lens and on the main body, spaces of sufficient size for the approval mark and the additional symbols.
The spaces for the approval mark and additional symbols shall be indicated on the drawings referred to in paragraph 2.2.1.
If the lens cannot be detached from the main body of the front fog lamp, a space for the approval mark on the lens or body shall be sufficient.
condition: if the lens cannot be detached from the main body

text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the device which cannot be separated from the transparent part of the device emitting light.
The approval marking shall be visible when the device is fitted on the vehicle, at least when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
Class F3 front fog lamps with LED module(s) shall bear the marking of the rated voltage, rated wattage and the light source module specific identification code.
condition: if fitted with LED module(s)

text: LED module(s) submitted with the application for approval of the lamp shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant; this marking must be clearly legible and indelible.
condition: if the LED module(s) are replaceable

text: LED module(s) submitted with the application for approval of the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module; this marking must be clearly legible and indelible.
condition: if the LED module(s) are replaceable

text: The LED module specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters "MD" for "Module" followed by the approval marking without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 4.2.1., followed by additional symbols or characters where several non-identical LED modules are used.
The LED module specific identification code shall be shown in the drawings mentioned in paragraph 2.2.1.
The approval marking on the LED module and the one on the lamp in which the module is used shall be from the same applicant.
Markings for LED module(s) are not required if the LED module(s) are non-replaceable.
condition: if the LED module(s) are non-replaceable

text: A light source control gear which is not part of the LED module shall be marked with its specific identification code(s), the rated input voltage and wattage.
condition: if a light source control gear not part of the LED module is used

text: Notice of approval, extension, refusal, withdrawal or production definitely discontinued shall be communicated to the Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a form conforming to the model in Annex 1, with the indications according to paragraph 2.2.

The requirements of sections 5 and 6 and referenced Annexes of Regulations Nos. 48, 53 or 86 pertinent to each lamp and to the vehicle category(ies) on which it is intended to be installed shall be applied, where verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
condition: where verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible

text: Each sample of front fog lamp submitted shall meet the specifications set forth in paragraphs 6 and 7 of this Regulation.

Front fog lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal use, despite vibrations, their satisfactory operation continues to be ensured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
The correct position of the lens of the front fog lamp shall be clearly marked.
The lens and reflector of the front fog lamp shall be so secured as to prevent any rotation during use.
Conformity with paragraph 5.2 shall be verified by visual inspection and, where necessary, by a trial fitting.

Front fog lamps shall be fitted with a device enabling them to be adjusted on the vehicles so as to comply with the rules applicable to them; such a device need not be fitted on units in which reflector and lens cannot be separated, provided their use is confined to vehicles on which the fog lamp setting can be adjusted by other means.
Where a front fog lamp and another front lamp, each with its own light source, form a composite unit, the adjusting device shall enable each optical system to be individually adjusted.
condition: if assembled with another front lamp into a composite unit

text: For front lamp assemblies whose reflectors are indivisible, the adjustment provisions of 5.2.1 do not apply and the requirements of paragraph 6.3.4 or 6.4.3 (as appropriate) shall apply.
condition: for front lamp assemblies with indivisible reflectors

text: Complementary tests shall be carried out according to Annex 5 to ensure that in use there is no excessive change in photometric performance of the front fog lamp.
If the lens of the front fog lamp is of plastic material, tests shall be carried out according to Annex 6.
condition: if the lens is of plastic material

text: The holder of a replaceable light source shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication No. 60061, using the holder data sheet relevant to the light source category.
condition: in the case of replaceable light sources

text: The replaceable light source shall fit easily into the front fog lamp.
condition: in the case of replaceable light sources

text: The design of the front fog lamp shall be such that the replaceable light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
condition: in the case of replaceable light sources

text: A Class B front fog lamp shall only be equipped with one filament light source approved according to Regulation No. 37, even if the filament light source cannot be replaced.
The R37 filament light source used in a Class B front fog lamp shall have an objective luminous flux not exceeding 2,000 lumens.
The R37 filament light source used in a Class B front fog lamp shall be one for which no restriction on use is made in Regulation No. 37 and its series of amendments in force.
A non-replaceable filament light source in a Class B front fog lamp shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.6.
condition: if the filament light source cannot be replaced

text: A Class F3 front fog lamp, irrespective of whether the light sources can be replaced, shall only be equipped with light sources approved according to Regulation No. 37 (provided no restriction on use is made) or Regulation No. 99, and/or LED modules.
Filament light sources used in a Class F3 front fog lamp shall be approved according to Regulation No. 37 and its series of amendments in force, with no restriction on their use.
condition: if R37 light sources are used

text: Gas discharge light sources used in a Class F3 front fog lamp shall be approved according to Regulation No. 99 and its series of amendments in force.
condition: if R99 light sources are used

text: LED modules used in a Class F3 front fog lamp shall meet the requirements of Annex 12, and compliance shall be tested.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: The design of the LED module(s) or light generator(s) shall be such that they can be fitted in no position other than the correct one.
condition: in the case of LED module or light generator

text: Non-identical light source modules, if any, shall be non-interchangeable within the same lamp housing.
condition: if non-identical modules are used

text: The LED module(s) shall be tamperproof.
For front fog lamps with light source(s) having a total objective luminous flux exceeding 2,000 lumen, a reference shall be made in paragraph 10 of the communication form in Annex 1.
condition: if total objective luminous flux exceeds 2,000 lumen

text: If the lens of the front fog lamp is made of plastic materials, tests shall be done according to Annex 6.
condition: if the lens is made of plastic material

text: The UV resistance of light transmitting components located inside the front fog lamp and made of plastic material shall be tested according to Annex 6, paragraph 2.7.
condition: unless low-UV type light sources are used or components are shielded from UV radiation

text: The UV resistance test of inner plastic components is not necessary if low-UV type light sources as specified in Regulation No. 99 or Annex 12 are used, or if provisions are taken to shield the relevant lamp components from UV radiation, e.g. by glass filters.
condition: if low-UV light sources are used or UV shielding is provided

text: The front fog lamp and its ballast system or light source control gear shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.

Front fog lamps designed to operate permanently with an additional system to control the intensity of the light emitted, including those reciprocally incorporated with another function using a common light source, are permitted.
condition: if designed to operate permanently with an intensity control system

text: For Class F3 front fog lamps, the sharpness and linearity of the cut-off shall be tested according to Annex 9.
Front fog lamps shall be so designed as to provide illumination with limited dazzle.
The luminous intensity produced by the front fog lamp shall be measured at 25 m distance by means of a photoelectric cell having a useful area comprised within a square of 65 mm side.
For Class B front fog lamps, a colourless standard (étalon) filament lamp as specified in Regulation No. 37, of the category specified by the manufacturer, shall be used for testing.

During testing of a Class B front fog lamp, the power supply for the standard filament lamp shall be regulated so as to obtain the reference luminous flux at 13.2 V as indicated in the relevant data sheet of Regulation No. 37.
During testing of a Class B front fog lamp where the filament lamp cannot be replaced, the voltage at the terminals of the front fog lamp shall be regulated at 13.2 V.
condition: if the filament lamp cannot be replaced

text: A Class B front fog lamp shall be deemed satisfactory if the photometric requirements are met with at least one standard filament lamp.
For Class B front fog lamps, the aiming screen for visual adjustment shall be positioned at either 10 m or 25 m in front of the front fog lamp.

The Class B front fog lamp beam shall produce on the aiming screen, over a width of not less than 5.0° on both sides of the line v, a symmetrical and substantially horizontal cut-off to enable visual vertical adjustment.
The Class B front fog lamp shall be so adjusted that the cut-off on the aiming screen is 1.15° below the line h.
When so adjusted, the Class B front fog lamp shall meet the requirements in paragraph 6.3.5.
The luminous intensity of a Class B front fog lamp shall be measured in either white or selective yellow light as prescribed by the manufacturer for use in normal service.
Variations detrimental to satisfactory visibility in either of Zones B and C of a Class B front fog lamp are not permitted.

In the Class B light distribution, single narrow spots or stripes inside the area above 15° with not more than 230 cd are allowed only if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.
condition: if spots or stripes are present above 15°

text: If multiple spots or stripes are present in the Class B light distribution above 15°, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.
condition: if multiple spots or stripes are present

text: For Class F3 front fog lamps, the photometric test conditions corresponding to the type of light source used shall apply.

A Class F3 front fog lamp with replaceable filament light sources shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 6.4.3. with at least one complete set of appropriate standard (étalon) lamps, which may be supplied by the manufacturer or applicant.
condition: in the case of replaceable filament light sources

text: A Class F3 front fog lamp shall be checked by means of colourless standard (étalon) filament lamps as specified in Regulation No. 37.
condition: in the case of replaceable filament lamps operating directly under vehicle voltage system conditions

text: During the testing of a Class F3 front fog lamp, the power supply to the filament lamp(s) shall be regulated so as to obtain the reference luminous flux at 13.2 V as indicated on the relevant data sheet of Regulation No. 37.
condition: in the case of replaceable filament lamps operating directly under vehicle voltage system conditions

text: For a Class F3 front fog lamp system that uses a light source control gear being part of the lamp, the voltage declared by the applicant shall be applied to the input terminals of that lamp.
condition: if the light source control gear is part of the lamp

text: For a Class F3 front fog lamp system that uses a light source control gear not being part of the lamp, the voltage declared by the applicant shall be applied to the input terminals of that light source control gear.
condition: if the light source control gear is not part of the lamp

text: The test laboratory shall require from the applicant the special light source control gear needed to supply the light source and the applicable functions.
condition: if the light source control gear is not part of the lamp

text: The identification of the light source control gear, if applicable, and/or the voltage applied including the tolerances shall be noted in the communication form in Annex 1.
condition: if the light source control gear is not part of the lamp

text: A Class F3 front fog lamp with a gas-discharge light source shall be tested with a standard light source as specified in Regulation No. 99, aged during at least 15 cycles in accordance with Annex 4, paragraph 4. of Regulation No. 99.
condition: in the case of a gas-discharge light source

text: During testing of a Class F3 front fog lamp with a gas-discharge light source, the voltage at the terminals of the ballast, or at the terminals of the light source if the ballast is integrated with the light source, shall be regulated to maintain 13.2 V for a 12 V system, or the vehicle voltage specified by the applicant, with a tolerance of ± 0.1 V.
condition: in the case of a gas-discharge light source

text: If the objective luminous flux of the gas-discharge light source differs from that specified in Regulation No. 99, the luminous intensity values shall be corrected accordingly.
condition: if the objective luminous flux differs from that specified in Regulation No. 99

text: All measurements on Class F3 front fog lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources shall be made at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V or at other vehicle voltage as specified by the applicant.
condition: in the case of non-replaceable light sources

text: For Class F3 front fog lamps with non-replaceable light sources, the test voltages shall be applied to the input terminals of the lamp.
condition: in the case of non-replaceable light sources

text: All measurements on Class F3 front fog lamps equipped with LED module(s) shall be made at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V respectively, if not otherwise specified within this Regulation.
condition: in the case of LED modules

text: LED modules operated by an electronic light source control gear shall be measured with the input voltage as specified by the applicant or with a supply and operating device which replaces this control gear for the photometric test.
condition: if LED modules are operated by an electronic light source control gear

text: The relevant input parameters (e.g. duty cycle, frequency, pulse shape, peak voltage) of LED modules operated by an electronic light source control gear shall be specified and stated in the communication form, item 10.6., in Annex 1.
condition: if LED modules are operated by an electronic light source control gear

text: Compliance with the requirements of paragraph 5.8.1. shall be verified at least with respect to the values in line 3 and line 4 of the table of paragraph 6.4.3.
For Class F3 front fog lamps, the aiming screen for visual adjustment shall be positioned at either a distance of 10 m or a distance of 25 m in front of the front fog lamp.

The beam of a Class F3 front fog lamp shall produce on the aiming screen, over a width of not less than 5.0 degrees on both sides of the line v, a symmetrical and substantially horizontal cut-off to enable visual vertical adjustment.

If visual aim of a Class F3 front fog lamp leads to problems or ambiguous positions, the measurement of the cut-off quality and the instrumental method as specified in paragraphs 4. and 5. of Annex 9 shall be applied.
condition: if visual aim leads to problems or ambiguous positions

text: The Class F3 front fog lamp shall be adjusted so that the cut-off on the screen is 1° below the line h according to the requirements in paragraph 2. of Annex 9.
When so adjusted, the Class F3 front fog lamp shall meet the photometric requirements in the table of paragraph 6.4.3.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp at points 1 and 2 (+60° vertical, ±45° horizontal) shall be 85 cd max.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp at points 3 and 4 (+40° vertical, ±30° horizontal) shall be 85 cd max.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp at points 5 and 6 (+30° vertical, ±60° horizontal) shall be 85 cd max.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp at points 7 and 10 (+20° vertical, ±40° horizontal) shall be 85 cd max.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp at points 8 and 9 (+20° vertical, ±15° horizontal) shall be 85 cd max.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp on line 1 (+8° vertical, -26° to +26° horizontal) shall be 130 cd max over the whole line.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp on line 2 (+4° vertical, -26° to +26° horizontal) shall be 150 cd max over the whole line.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp on line 3 (+2° vertical, -26° to +26° horizontal) shall be 245 cd max over the whole line.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp on line 4 (+1° vertical, -26° to +26° horizontal) shall be 360 cd max over the whole line.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp on line 5 (0° vertical, -10° to +10° horizontal) shall be 485 cd max over the whole line.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp on line 6 (-2.5° vertical, -10° to +10° horizontal) shall be 2700 cd min over the whole line.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp on line 7 (-6.0° vertical, -10° to +10° horizontal) shall be < 50 per cent of the maximum on line 6 over the whole line.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp on lines 8L and 8R (-1.5° to -3.5° vertical, at -22° and +22° horizontal) shall be 1,100 cd min at one or more points.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp on lines 9L and 9R (-1.5° to -4.5° vertical, at -35° and +35° horizontal) shall be 450 cd min at one or more points.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp in Zone D (-1.5° to -3.5° vertical, -10° to +10° horizontal) shall be 12,000 cd max over the whole zone.
The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp shall be measured either with white light or coloured light as prescribed by the applicant for use of the fog lamp in normal service.
Variations in homogeneity detrimental to satisfactory visibility in the zone above line 5 from 10 degrees left to 10 degrees right are not permitted for a Class F3 front fog lamp.

At the request of the applicant, two Class F3 front fog lamps constituting a matched pair corresponding to paragraph 4.2.2.5. may be tested separately; in this case the requirements for lines 6, 7, 8, 9 and Zone D in the table of paragraph 6.4.3. apply to half the sum of readings of the right-hand and left-hand side front fog lamp.
condition: if a matched pair is tested separately at the request of the applicant

text: Each of the two front fog lamps of a matched pair tested separately shall meet at least 50 per cent of the minimum value required for line 6.
condition: if a matched pair is tested separately at the request of the applicant

text: Each of the two front fog lamps constituting a matched pair corresponding to paragraph 4.2.2.5. is only required to meet the requirements of line 6 and line 7 from 5° inwards to 10° outwards.
condition: if a matched pair is tested separately

text: Inside the field between lines 1 to 5 in Figure 3 of Annex 4, the beam pattern of a Class F3 front fog lamp should be substantially uniform.
Discontinuities in intensities detrimental to satisfactory visibility between lines 6, 7, 8 and 9 are not permitted for a Class F3 front fog lamp.

Single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1, or inside the area of line 1 and line 2, are allowed only with not more than 175 cd and if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.
condition: if narrow spots or stripes are present

text: If multiple spots or stripes are present in the area of points 1 to 10 and lines 1 and 2, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.
condition: if multiple spots or stripes are present

text: If the specified luminous intensity requirements are not met, a re-aim of the cut-off position within ± 0.5° vertical and/or ± 2° horizontal is allowed, and in the re-aimed position all photometric requirements shall be met.
condition: if the specified luminous intensity requirements are not met

text: The luminous intensity of a Class F3 front fog lamp shall exceed 1080 cd at the measuring point 0° horizontal and 2° D vertical, four seconds after activation of the fog lamp which has not been operated for 30 minutes or more.
condition: if equipped with gas-discharge light sources with the ballast not integrated with the light source

text: Automatic variation of the luminous intensities to adapt to dense fog or similar conditions of reduced visibility is permitted only if an active electronic light source control gear is incorporated into the front fog lamp function system.
condition: if luminous intensities are varied automatically

text: Automatic variation of the luminous intensities is permitted only if all intensities are varied proportionately.
condition: if luminous intensities are varied automatically

text: The adaptive front fog lamp system, when checked according to paragraph 6.4.1.1.2., is acceptable only if the luminous intensities remain within 60 per cent and 100 per cent of the values specified in the table in paragraph 6.4.3.
condition: if luminous intensities are varied automatically

text: For a front fog lamp with automatically variable luminous intensity, an indication shall be inserted in the communication form (Annex 1, paragraph 10.).
condition: if luminous intensities are varied automatically

text: The Technical Service responsible for type approval shall verify that the variable intensity system provides automatic modifications such that good road illumination is achieved and no discomfort is caused to the driver or to other road users.
condition: if luminous intensities are varied automatically

text: Photometric measurements of a front fog lamp with automatically variable luminous intensity shall be performed according to the applicant's description.
condition: if luminous intensities are varied automatically

text: The colour of the light emitted by the front fog lamp shall be either white or selective yellow by choice of the applicant.
The selective yellow colour of the beam, if any, may be obtained by the colour of the light source, by the lens of the front fog lamp or by any other suitable means.
condition: if the colour is selective yellow

text: The colorimetric characteristics of the front fog lamp shall be measured with voltages as defined in paragraphs 6.3. and 6.4.
The discomfort dazzle caused by the front fog lamp shall be determined.
Front fog lamps shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved under this Regulation, with compliance with paragraphs 6. and 7. verified as set out in paragraph 10.
The minimum requirements for Conformity of Production control procedures set forth in Annex 7 shall be complied with.
The minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 8 shall be complied with.
Suitable controls of the production shall be carried out to verify that the requirements of paragraph 10.1. are met.
The holder of the approval shall ensure the existence of procedures for the effective control of the quality of products.
The holder of the approval shall have access to the control equipment necessary for checking the conformity to each approved type.
The holder of the approval shall ensure that data of test results are recorded and that related documents remain available for a period to be determined in accordance with the Administrative Service.

The holder of the approval shall analyse the results of each type of test in order to verify and ensure the stability of the product characteristics, making allowance for variation of an industrial production.
The holder of the approval shall ensure that for each type of product at least the tests prescribed in Annex 7 with the tolerances prescribed in Annex 2 are carried out.
The holder of the approval shall ensure that any collecting of samples giving evidence of non-conformity with the type of test considered gives rise to another sampling and another test.
condition: if samples show non-conformity

text: All the necessary steps shall be taken to re-establish the conformity of the corresponding production.
condition: if samples show non-conformity

text: The competent authority which has granted type approval may at any time verify the conformity control methods applicable to each production unit.
In every inspection, the test books and production survey records shall be presented to the visiting inspector.
The inspector may take samples at random to be tested in the manufacturer's laboratory; the minimum number of samples may be determined in the light of the results of the manufacturer's own checks.

When the quality level appears unsatisfactory or when it seems necessary to verify the validity of the tests carried out under paragraph 10.4.2., the inspector shall select samples to be sent to the technical service that conducted the type approval tests, using the criteria of Annex 7 with the tolerances prescribed in Annex 2.
condition: when the quality level appears unsatisfactory or verification of test validity is necessary

text: The Competent Authority may carry out any test prescribed in this Regulation on samples selected at random without causing distortion of the manufacturer's delivery commitments and in accordance with the criteria of Annex 7 with the tolerances prescribed in Annex 2.
The Competent Authority shall strive to obtain a frequency of inspection of once every two years, at the discretion of the competent authority.
Where negative results are recorded, the competent authority shall ensure that all necessary steps are taken to re-establish the conformity of production as rapidly as possible.
condition: where negative results are recorded

text: Front fog lamps with apparent defects are disregarded in conformity of production checks.

When testing photometric performances of any Class B front fog lamp chosen at random and equipped with a standard filament lamp, no measured value may deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the value prescribed in this Regulation.
For the periodic records of Class B front fog lamps, the reading is limited to point B50 (horizontal 0°, vertical 0.86°U) and the left and right bottom corners of zone D.

When testing the photometric performances of any Class F3 front fog lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 6.4., no measured value of the luminous intensity may deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent.

When testing the photometric performances of any Class F3 front fog lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 6.4., no measured value of the luminous intensity may deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent.

For the periodic records of Class F3 front fog lamps, the photometric measurements for verification of conformity shall at least yield data for points 8 and 9 and lines 1, 5, 6, 8 and 9 as specified in paragraph 6.4.3.
The approval number and the additional symbols shall be placed close to the circle and either above or below the letter "E", or to the right or left of that letter.
The digits of the approval number shall be on the same side of the letter "E" and face the same direction.
The use of Roman numerals as approval numbers should be avoided so as to prevent any confusion with other symbols.
The dimension a of the approval mark arrangement shall be ≥ 5 mm.
Where a lens of plastic material is used for different types of headlamps reciprocally incorporated with a front fog lamp, the main body of the headlamp shall bear only the valid approval number.
condition: if the same lens is used for different types of lamps reciprocally incorporated with a front fog lamp

text: Once the photometric values have been measured in the point of maximum illumination in zone D (Emax) and in the point HV, a complete front fog lamp sample, including those surrounding body parts and lamps which could influence its thermal dissipation, shall be tested for stability of photometric performance in operation.

The stability of photometric performance tests shall be carried out in a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C, the test sample being mounted on a base representing the correct installation on the vehicle.
In case of replaceable filament light sources, the stability tests shall be carried out using mass production filament light sources which have been aged for at least one hour.
condition: in case of replaceable filament light sources

text: In case of replaceable gas-discharge light sources, the stability tests shall be carried out using mass production gas-discharge light sources which have been aged for at least 15 hours.
condition: in case of replaceable gas-discharge light sources

text: In case of LED modules, the stability tests shall be carried out using mass production LED modules which have been aged for at least 48 hours and cooled down to ambient temperature before starting the tests.
condition: in case of LED modules

text: The LED modules supplied by the applicant shall be used for the stability of photometric performance tests.
condition: in case of LED modules

text: The measuring equipment for the stability of photometric performance tests shall be equivalent to that used during headlamp type approval tests.
The front fog lamp test sample shall be operated without being dismounted from or readjusted in relation to its test fixture.
The light source used in the stability of photometric performance tests shall be a light source of the category specified for that front fog lamp.
The clean front fog lamp shall be operated for 12 hours as described in Annex 5 paragraph 1.1.1. and checked as prescribed in paragraph 1.1.2.
In the case where only one lighting function (front fog lamp) is to be approved, the corresponding light source is lit for the prescribed time.
condition: only one lighting function (front fog lamp) is to be approved

text: In the case of more than one lighting function, the headlamp shall be subjected to the cycle 15 minutes front fog lamp lit and 5 minutes all filaments lit until the prescribed time is reached.
condition: more than one lighting function

text: If the applicant declares that only one lighting function is to be used at a time, the test shall be carried out accordingly, successively activating the front fog lamp half of the time and one of the other lighting functions for half the time specified in paragraph 1.1.
condition: applicant declares only one lighting function is used at a time

text: When the tested front fog lamp includes signalling lamps, the latter shall be lit for the duration of the stability test, except for a daytime running lamp.
condition: tested front fog lamp includes signalling lamps

text: A direction indicator lamp included in the tested front fog lamp shall be lit in flashing operation mode with an on/off time ratio of approximately one to one during the stability test.
condition: tested front fog lamp includes a direction indicator lamp

text: In the case of a front fog lamp with a passing beam and one or more lighting functions, the front fog lamp shall be subjected to the cycle 15 minutes passing-beam light source(s) lit and 5 minutes all light source(s) lit until the time specified is reached.
condition: front fog lamp with a passing beam and one or more lighting functions

text: If the applicant declares that the front fog lamp is to be used with only the passing beam or only the front fog lamp lit at a time, the test shall be carried out successively activating the passing beam half of the time and the front fog lamp half of the time specified in paragraph 1.1., the driving beam(s) being subjected to a cycle of 15 minutes off and 5 minutes lit for half of the time and during the operation of the passing beam.
condition: applicant declares only passing beam or only front fog lamp lit at a time

text: If the applicant declares that the front fog lamp can be used with only the passing beam, only the driving beam(s) or only the front fog lamp lit at a time, the test shall be carried out successively activating the passing beam one third of the time, the driving beam(s) one third of the time and the front fog lamp one third of the time specified in paragraph 1.1.
condition: applicant declares only passing beam, only driving beam(s) or only front fog lamp lit at a time

text: When the tested headlamp includes signalling lamps, the latter shall be lit for the duration of the test; a direction indicator lamp shall be lit in flashing mode with an on/off time of approximately one to one.
condition: tested headlamp includes signalling lamps

text: For replaceable filament light source(s) operated directly under vehicle voltage system conditions, the stability test shall be performed at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V as applicable, or, if the applicant specifies a different voltage, with the filament light source operated at the highest voltage that can be used.
condition: replaceable filament light source(s) operated directly under vehicle voltage

text: For replaceable gas discharge light source(s), the test voltage for the electronic light source control-gear is 13.2 ± 0.1 volts for 12 V vehicle voltage system, or otherwise specified in the application for approval.
condition: replaceable gas discharge light source(s)

text: For non-replaceable light sources operated directly under vehicle voltage system conditions, all measurements shall be made at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V or at other voltages according to the vehicle voltage system as specified by the applicant.
condition: non-replaceable light source operated directly under vehicle voltage

text: For light sources operated independently from vehicle supply voltage and fully controlled by the system, or supplied by a supply and operating device, the test voltages shall be applied to the input terminals of that device; the test laboratory may require the supply and operating device or a special power supply from the manufacturer.
condition: light sources operated independently from vehicle supply voltage or supplied by a supply and operating device

text: LED module(s) shall be measured at 6.75 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V respectively, if not otherwise specified within this Regulation; LED module(s) operated by an electronic light source control gear shall be measured as specified by the applicant.
condition: LED module(s)

text: Where signalling lamps grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated into the test sample operate at voltages other than 6 V, 12 V or 24 V, the voltage shall be adjusted as declared by the manufacturer for the correct photometric functioning of that lamp.
condition: signalling lamps operating at voltages other than nominal rated voltages

text: For a gas-discharge light source, the test voltage for the ballast, or for the light source if the ballast is integrated, is 13.2 ± 0.1 volts for 12 V network system, or otherwise specified in the application for approval.
condition: gas-discharge light source

text: After stabilisation to ambient temperature, the front fog lamp lens and external lens, if any, shall be cleaned with a clean, damp cotton cloth and inspected visually; no distortion, deformation, cracking or change in colour of either lens shall be noticeable.
For Class B front fog lamps, the photometric values after the stability test shall be verified at point HV and the point of Imax in zone D.
condition: Class B

text: For Class F3 front fog lamps, the photometric values after the stability test shall be verified on line 5 at point h = 0 and the point of Imax in zone D.
condition: Class F3

text: The discrepancy between the photometric characteristics after the stability test and the values measured prior to the test shall not exceed 10 per cent including the tolerances of the photometric procedure; another aiming may be carried out to allow for deformation of the lamp base due to heat.

The front fog lamp, having been tested as in paragraph 1.1., shall be operated for one hour as described in paragraph 1.1.1. and, after preparation per paragraph 1.2.1., checked as prescribed in paragraph 1.1.3.

For front fog lamps with an outside lens in glass, the dirt test mixture shall be composed of 9 parts by weight of silica sand (0-100 µm), 1 part by weight of vegetal carbon dust from beech wood (0-100 µm), 0.2 part by weight of NaCMC, 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride (pure at 99 per cent) and an appropriate quantity of distilled water with a conductivity of ≤ 1 mS/m, and shall not be more than 14 days old.
condition: outside lens in glass

text: For front fog lamps with an outside lens in plastic material, the dirt test mixture shall be composed of 9 parts by weight of silica sand (0-100 µm), 1 part by weight of vegetal carbon dust from beech wood (0-100 µm), 0.2 part by weight of NaCMC, 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride (pure at 99 per cent), 13 parts by weight of distilled water with a conductivity of ≤ 1 mS/m and 2 ± 1 drops of surfactant, and shall not be more than 14 days old.
condition: outside lens in plastic material

text: The NaCMC used in the dirt mixture shall have a degree of substitution (DS) of 0.6-0.7 and a viscosity of 200-300 µP for a 2 per cent solution at 20 ºC.

The test mixture shall be uniformly applied to the entire light emitting surface of the front fog lamp and left to dry, repeated until the illumination value at the point of Emax in zone D has dropped to 15-20 per cent of the values measured.

The front fog lamp tested in accordance with paragraph 1 shall be subjected to the cut-off vertical drift test of paragraph 2.1. without being removed from or readjusted in relation to its test fixture; the vertical drift of the cut-off line under the influence of heat shall not exceed the specified value.

The cut-off drift test shall be carried out in a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C, using a mass production light source aged for at least one hour, with the voltage adjusted as specified in paragraph 1.1.2., without dismounting or readjusting the lamp.

The position of the cut-off line between 3.0 degrees left and 3.0 degrees right of line VV shall be verified after three minutes (r3) and 60 minutes (r60) of operation, by any method giving acceptable accuracy and reproducible results.
The absolute value ∆rI = |r3 - r60| of the cut-off line drift recorded on the front fog lamp shall be not more than 2 mrad.

If ∆r is more than 2 mrad but not more than 3 mrad, a further front fog lamp sample mounted on a fixture representative of vehicle installation shall be tested per paragraph 2.1. after three consecutive cycles of one hour operation (voltage per paragraph 1.1.2.) and one hour switched off.
condition: 2 mrad < ∆r ≤ 3 mrad

text: After the three cycles, the front fog lamp type shall be considered acceptable only if the absolute values ∆r measured on the further sample are not more than 2 mrad.
condition: 2 mrad < ∆r ≤ 3 mrad on first sample

text: The plastic lens or material samples supplied pursuant to paragraph 2.2.2. shall satisfy the specifications in Annex 6 paragraphs 2.1. to 2.5.
condition: lens of plastic material

text: The two samples of complete lamps incorporating lenses of plastic material shall, with regard to the lens material, satisfy the specifications in Annex 6 paragraph 2.6.
condition: lens of plastic material

text: Samples of plastic lenses or of material shall be subjected, with the reflector to which they are intended to be fitted (where applicable), to approval tests in the chronological order of table A of Appendix 1 to Annex 6.
condition: lens of plastic material

text: If the lamp manufacturer proves that the product has already passed the tests of paragraphs 2.1. to 2.5. or equivalent tests under another Regulation, those tests need not be repeated, but the tests of Appendix 1 table B shall be mandatory.
condition: product already passed tests 2.1 to 2.5 or equivalent

text: Three new plastic lens samples shall be subjected to five cycles of: 3 h at 40 °C ± 2 °C and 85-95 per cent RH; 1 h at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH; 15 h at -30 °C ± 2 °C; 1 h at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH; 3 h at 80 °C ± 2 °C; 1 h at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH.
Before the temperature change test, the samples shall be kept at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH for at least four hours.
Photometric measurements shall be carried out on the samples before and after the temperature change test under the conditions of paragraph 6.3. or 6.4.
For Class B front fog lamps, the photometric measurements shall be made at point HV and at point h = 0, v = 2° D in zone D.
condition: Class B

text: For Class F3 front fog lamps, the photometric measurements shall be made at the intersection of the VV line with line 6 and the intersection of the VV line with line 4.
condition: Class F3

text: The variation between the photometric values measured on each sample before and after the temperature change test shall not exceed 10 per cent including the tolerances of the photometric procedure.

Three new samples shall be exposed to radiation from a source with spectral energy distribution similar to a black body at 5,500 K to 6,000 K, with filters reducing as far as possible wavelengths smaller than 295 nm and greater than 2,500 nm.
The samples shall be exposed to an energetic illumination of 1,200 W/m2 ± 200 W/m2 until they receive a luminous energy of 4,500 MJ/m2 ± 200 MJ/m2, with a black panel temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C.
The samples shall revolve around the radiation source at a speed between 1 and 5 1/min.
The samples shall be sprayed with distilled water of conductivity lower than 1 µS/m at 23 °C ± 5 °C in a cycle of 5 minutes spraying and 25 minutes drying.
After the atmospheric agents test and transmission measurement, the outer face of the three samples shall be treated as described in paragraph 2.2.2.2. with the mixture of paragraph 2.2.2.1.

The chemical test mixture shall be composed of 61.5 per cent n-heptane, 12.5 per cent toluene, 7.5 per cent ethyl tetrachloride, 12.5 per cent trichlorethylene and 6 per cent xylene (volume per cent).

A cotton cloth (ISO 105) saturated with the test mixture shall, within 10 seconds, be applied for 10 minutes to the outer face of the sample at a pressure of 50 N/cm2 (100 N on 14 x 14 mm), re-soaked during the period so the liquid composition remains identical; the pressure may be compensated to prevent cracks.

After application of the test mixture, the samples shall be dried in open air, washed with the detergent solution of paragraph 2.3. at 23 °C ± 5 °C, rinsed with distilled water containing not more than 0.2 per cent impurities at 23 °C ± 5 °C and wiped off with a soft cloth.
After the test of resistance to atmospheric agents, the outer face of the samples shall be free from cracks, scratches, chipping and deformation.
After the test of resistance to atmospheric agents, the mean variation in transmission ∆t = (T2 - T3)/T2 measured on the three samples per Appendix 2 shall not exceed 0.020 (∆tm ≤ 0.020).
After the test of resistance to chemical agents, the samples shall not bear any traces of chemical staining likely to cause a variation of flux diffusion.
After the test of resistance to chemical agents, the mean variation in diffusion ∆d = (T5 - T4)/T2 measured on the three samples per Appendix 2 shall not exceed 0.020 (∆dm ≤ 0.020).

The outer face of three samples shall be heated to 50 °C ± 5 °C and immersed for five minutes in a mixture at 23 °C ± 5 °C of 99 parts distilled water (not more than 0.02 per cent impurities) and one part alkylaryl sulphonate, then dried at 50 °C ± 5 °C and cleaned with a moist cloth.

The outer face of the three samples shall then be lightly rubbed for one minute with a cotton cloth soaked in a mixture of 70 per cent n-heptane and 30 per cent toluene (volume per cent) and dried in the open air.

After the detergent and hydrocarbon tests performed successively, the mean variation in transmission ∆t = (T2 - T3)/T2 measured on the three samples per Appendix 2 shall not exceed 0.010 (∆tm ≤ 0.010).
The outer face of three new samples (lenses) of plastic material shall be subjected to the uniform mechanical deterioration test by the method described in Appendix 3 to Annex 6.
condition: if the lens is of plastic material

text: After the mechanical deterioration test, the variations in transmission ∆t = (T2 - T3) / T2 and in diffusion ∆d = (T5 - T4) / T2 shall be measured according to the procedure described in Appendix 2 in the area specified in paragraph 2.2.4.1.1.
condition: if the lens is of plastic material

text: After the mechanical deterioration test, the mean value of the variation in transmission of the three plastic lens samples shall be ∆tm ≤ 0.010.
condition: if the lens is of plastic material

text: After the mechanical deterioration test, the mean value of the variation in diffusion of the three plastic lens samples shall be ∆dm ≤ 0.050.
condition: if the lens is of plastic material

text: For the coating adherence test, a surface of 20 mm x 20 mm in area of the coating of a lens shall be grated with a razor blade or a needle into a grid of squares approximately 2 mm x 2 mm.
condition: if the lens has a coating

text: The pressure on the blade or needle used to grate the coating shall be sufficient to cut at least the coating.
condition: if the lens has a coating

text: The coating adherence test shall use an adhesive tape with a force of adhesion of 2 N/(cm of width) ± 20 per cent measured under the standardized conditions specified in Appendix 4 to Annex 6.
condition: if the lens has a coating

text: The adhesive tape shall be at least 25 mm wide and shall be pressed for at least five minutes to the grated coating surface.
condition: if the lens has a coating

text: The end of the adhesive tape shall be loaded in such a way that a force perpendicular to the surface balances the force of adhesion, and the tape shall then be torn off at a constant speed of 1.5 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
condition: if the lens has a coating

text: After the adherence test there shall be no appreciable impairment of the grated area of the lens coating.
condition: if the lens has a coating

text: Impairments of the coating at the intersections between squares or at the edges of the cuts are permitted only provided that the impaired area does not exceed 15 per cent of the grated surface.
condition: if the lens has a coating

text: The plastic lens of complete lamp sample No. 1 shall be subjected to the mechanical deterioration test described in Annex 6 paragraph 2.4.1.
condition: if the front fog lamp incorporates a lens of plastic material

text: After the mechanical deterioration test of the lens of a complete Class B front fog lamp, the photometric measurements in zone B shall not exceed the maximum values prescribed by more than 30 per cent.
condition: if the front fog lamp incorporates a lens of plastic material

text: After the mechanical deterioration test of the lens of a complete Class F3 front fog lamp, the photometric measurements on lines 2 and 5 shall not exceed the maximum values prescribed by more than 30 per cent.
condition: if the front fog lamp incorporates a lens of plastic material

text: The lens of complete lamp sample No. 2 shall be subjected to the coating adherence test described in Annex 6 paragraph 2.5.
condition: if the plastic lens has a coating

text: Flat samples of each light transmitting plastic component inside the front fog lamp shall be exposed to the light of the gas-discharge light source with the same parameters such as angles and distances as in the front fog lamp.
condition: in the case of gas-discharge light sources

text: After 1,500 hours of continuous exposure to the gas-discharge light source, the colorimetric specifications of the light transmitted by the plastic component samples must be met with a new standard gas-discharge light source.
condition: in the case of gas-discharge light sources

text: After 1,500 hours of continuous exposure to the gas-discharge light source, the surface of the plastic component samples shall be free of cracks, scratches, scaling or deformation.
condition: in the case of gas-discharge light sources

text: For conformity of production of lens materials, after the test for resistance to chemical agents and the test for resistance to detergents and hydrocarbons, the outer face of the samples shall exhibit no cracks, chipping or deformation visible to the naked eye.
condition: if the lens is of plastic material

text: For conformity of production of lens materials, after the mechanical deterioration test of paragraph 2.6.1.1, the photometric values at the points of measurement of paragraph 2.6.1.2 shall be within the limits prescribed for conformity of production by this Regulation.
condition: if the lens is of plastic material

text: If the lens material conformity of production test results fail to satisfy the requirements, the tests shall be repeated on another sample of front fog lamps selected at random.
condition: if the test results fail to satisfy the requirements

text: Complete front fog lamp sample No. 1 shall be subjected to the deterioration test of paragraph 2.6.1.1 (Appendix 1, Table B).
condition: if the front fog lamp incorporates a lens of plastic material

text: Complete front fog lamp sample No. 1 shall be subjected to the photometry check of paragraph 2.6.1.2 after deterioration (Appendix 1, Table B).
condition: if the front fog lamp incorporates a lens of plastic material

text: Complete front fog lamp sample No. 2 shall be subjected to the adherence test of paragraph 2.6.2 (Appendix 1, Table B).
condition: if the plastic lens has a coating

text: In the diffusion and transmission measuring equipment, the beam of a collimator K with a half divergence β/2 = 17.4 x 10-4 rd shall be limited by a diaphragm DT with an opening of 6 mm against which the sample stand is placed.

The diameter of the convergent achromatic lens L2, corrected for spherical aberrations, shall be such that it does not diaphragm the light diffused by the sample in a cone with a half top angle of β/2 = 14°.

An annular diaphragm DD with angles a/2 = 1° and amax/2 = 12° shall be placed in an image focal plane of the lens L2, and it shall be possible to remove its central part from the light beam so that it returns exactly to its original position.
The distance L2 DT and the focal length F2 of the lens L2 shall be so chosen that the image of DT completely covers the receiver R.
When the initial incident flux is referred to 1,000 units, the absolute precision of each transmission/diffusion reading shall be better than 1 unit.

The spray gun used for the mechanical deterioration test shall be equipped with a nozzle 1.3 mm in diameter allowing a liquid flow rate of 0.24 ± 0.02 l/minute at an operating pressure of 6.0 bars - 0, + 0.5 bar.
Under the specified operating conditions the spray fan pattern shall be 170 mm ± 50 mm in diameter on the surface exposed to deterioration, at a distance of 380 mm ± 10 mm from the nozzle.

The spray test mixture shall be composed of silica sand of hardness 7 on the Mohs scale, with a grain size between 0 and 0.2 mm, an almost normal distribution and an angular factor of 1.8 to 2, and water of hardness not exceeding 205 g/m3, with 25 g of sand per litre of water.
The outer surface of the lamp lenses shall be subjected once or more than once to the sand jet, sprayed almost perpendicular to the surface to be tested.

The deterioration shall be checked by means of one or more glass reference samples placed near the lenses, and the mixture shall be sprayed until the variation in diffusion on the reference sample(s) is Δd = (T5 - T4) / T2 ≤ 0.0250 ± 0.0025.
The adhesive tape adherence test shall be carried out at ambient conditions of 23 °C ± 5 °C and 65 ± 15 per cent relative humidity.

Before the test, the sample roll of adhesive tape shall be conditioned for 24 hours in the specified atmosphere; five test pieces each 400 mm long shall be tested from each roll, taken after the first three turns were discarded.

The five tape test pieces shall be unrolled radially at approximately 300 mm/s and applied to the glass plate within 15 seconds with a slight longitudinal rubbing movement of the finger without excessive pressure, then left for 10 minutes in the specified atmospheric conditions.

About 25 mm of the tape test piece shall be unstuck, the free end folded back at 90°, and the tape pulled with the force perpendicular to the separation line and to the plate at a speed of 300 mm/s ± 30 mm/s, recording the force required.
The five adhesion values shall be arranged in order and the median value taken as the result, expressed in Newton per centimetre of width of the tape.

Conformity of production shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
The conformity of mass-produced front fog lamps shall not be contested if the photometric performances according to Annex 2 for the prevailing class of front fog lamp are satisfied.
If the photometric results do not meet the requirements, the tests on the front fog lamp shall be repeated using light sources as specified in paragraphs 6.3 or 6.4, as appropriate.
condition: if the results do not meet the requirements

text: If the results do not meet the requirements, the alignment of the front fog lamp may be changed only provided that the beam axis is not displaced laterally by more than 0.5° to the right or left and not by more than 0.2° up or down; in the re-aimed position all photometric requirements shall be met.
condition: if the results do not meet the requirements

text: For conformity of production, one of the sampled front fog lamps shall be tested according to Annex 5 paragraph 2.1 after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle described in Annex 5 paragraph 2.2.2.
The sampled front fog lamp shall be considered acceptable if ∆r of the cut-off line does not exceed 3.0 mrad.
If ∆r exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad, a second front fog lamp shall be tested, and the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 3.0 mrad.
condition: if ∆r exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad

text: The chromaticity coordinates of production front fog lamps shall comply with paragraph 7 of this Regulation.
The photometric performance of a front fog lamp emitting selective yellow light when equipped with a colourless light source shall be the values contained in this Regulation multiplied by 0.84.
condition: if the lamp emits selective yellow light with a colourless light source

text: For each type of front fog lamp the holder of the approval mark shall carry out at least the prescribed conformity tests at appropriate intervals, in accordance with the provisions of this Regulation.

If any sampling shows non-conformity with regard to the type of test concerned, further samples shall be taken and tested, and the manufacturer shall take steps to ensure the conformity of the production concerned.
condition: if any sampling shows non-conformity

text: Conformity tests shall cover the photometric characteristics and the verification of the change in vertical position of the cut-off line under the influence of heat.
Conformity tests shall generally be carried out in accordance with the methods set out in this Regulation.

In conformity tests carried out by the manufacturer, equivalent methods may be used only with the consent of the competent authority, and the manufacturer shall prove that the applied methods are equivalent to those of this Regulation.
condition: if equivalent methods are used

text: Test apparatus used for conformity tests shall be regularly calibrated and correlated with measurements made by a competent authority.
In all cases the reference methods shall be those of this Regulation, particularly for administrative verification and sampling.
Samples of front fog lamps shall be selected at random from the production of a uniform batch, and the assessment shall in general cover series production from individual factories.
A manufacturer may group together records concerning the same type from several factories only provided these operate under the same quality system and quality management.
condition: if records from several factories are grouped

text: The sampled front fog lamp shall be subjected to photometric measurements at the points provided for in the Regulation, the reading being limited to points listed in Annex 2 for the prevailing class of front fog lamp.
The manufacturer shall carry out a statistical study of the test results and define, in agreement with the competent authority, criteria governing the acceptability of his products.
The acceptability criteria shall be such that, with a confidence level of 95 per cent, the minimum probability of passing a spot check in accordance with Annex 8 (first sampling) would be 0.95.

In inspector sampling, conformity shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
In inspector sampling, the conformity of mass-produced front fog lamps shall not be contested if the photometric performances according to Annex 2 for the prevailing class are satisfied.
If the results do not meet the requirements, the tests on the front fog lamp shall be repeated using light sources as specified in paragraphs 6.3 or 6.4, as appropriate.
condition: if the results do not meet the requirements

text: If the results do not meet the requirements, the alignment of the front fog lamp may be changed only provided that the beam axis is not displaced laterally by more than 0.5° to the right or left and not by more than 0.2° up or down; in the re-aimed position all photometric requirements shall be met.
condition: if the results do not meet the requirements

text: If the specified luminous intensity requirements are not met, a re-aim of the cut-off position within ±0.5° vertical and/or ±2° horizontal is allowed; in the re-aimed position all photometric requirements shall be met.
condition: if the specified luminous intensity requirements are not met

text: If vertical adjustment cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the allowed tolerances, the instrumental method of Annex 9 shall be applied and the quality of cut-off tested on one sample.
condition: if vertical adjustment cannot be performed repeatedly within tolerances

text: Front fog lamps with obvious defects shall be disregarded in inspector sampling.
In inspector sampling, the chromaticity coordinates shall comply with paragraph 7 of this Regulation.

In inspector sampling, the photometric performance of a front fog lamp emitting selective yellow light when equipped with a colourless light source shall be the values contained in this Regulation multiplied by 0.84.
condition: if the lamp emits selective yellow light with a colourless light source

text: In the first sampling four front fog lamps shall be selected at random; the first sample of two marked A and the second sample of two marked B.

The conformity of mass-produced front fog lamps shall not be contested if the deviation of any specimen of samples A and B (all four lamps) is not more than 20 per cent; if the deviation of both lamps of sample A is not more than 0 per cent, the measurement can be closed.
The conformity of mass-produced front fog lamps shall be contested if the deviation of at least one specimen of samples A or B is more than 20 per cent.
condition: if the deviation of at least one specimen of samples A or B is more than 20 per cent

text: When conformity is contested in the first sampling, the manufacturer shall be requested to bring his production in line with the requirements and a repeated sampling according to paragraph 3 shall be carried out within two months after the notification.
condition: if conformity is contested after the first sampling

text: Samples A and B shall be retained by the Technical Service until the entire CoP process is finished.
condition: if conformity is contested after the first sampling

text: In the first repeated sampling, four lamps shall be selected at random from stock manufactured after alignment; the first sample of two marked C and the second sample of two marked D.

The conformity of mass-produced front fog lamps shall not be contested if the deviation of any specimen of samples C and D (all four lamps) is not more than 20 per cent; if the deviation of both lamps of sample C is not more than 0 per cent, the measurement can be closed.

The conformity of mass-produced front fog lamps shall be contested if the deviation of at least one specimen of samples C or D is more than 20 per cent but the deviation of all specimens is not more than 30 per cent; the manufacturer shall be requested again to align production and a second repeated sampling according to paragraph 4 shall be carried out within two months after the notification.
condition: if one specimen of samples C or D deviates more than 20 per cent but all not more than 30 per cent

text: Samples C and D shall be retained by the Technical Service until the entire CoP process is finished.
condition: if conformity is contested after the first repeated sampling

text: If the deviation of at least one specimen of samples C and D is more than 30 per cent, the approval shall be withdrawn and paragraph 5 of Annex 8 shall be applied.
condition: if one specimen of samples C and D deviates more than 30 per cent

text: In the second repeated sampling, a sample of four front fog lamps shall be selected at random from stock manufactured after alignment; the first sample of two is marked E, the second sample of two is marked F.
condition: if a second repeated sampling is required

text: The conformity of mass-produced front fog lamps shall not be contested if the deviation of any specimen of samples E and F (all four lamps) is not more than 20 per cent; if the deviation of both lamps of sample E is not more than 0 per cent, the measurement can be closed.
condition: second repeated sampling

text: The conformity of mass-produced front fog lamps shall be contested if the deviation of at least one specimen of samples E or F is more than 20 per cent; in this case the approval shall be withdrawn and paragraph 5 of Annex 8 shall be applied.
condition: second repeated sampling

text: Where the sampling procedure leads to withdrawal, the approval shall be withdrawn according to paragraph 11 of the Regulation.
condition: if conformity is contested leading to withdrawal

text: For verification of the change in vertical position of the cut-off line under the influence of heat, one of the front fog lamps of sample A shall be tested according to the procedure of paragraph 2.1 of Annex 4 after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle of paragraph 2.2.2 of Annex 4.
The sampled front fog lamp shall be considered acceptable if ∆r does not exceed 3.0 mrad.
If ∆r exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad, the second front fog lamp of sample A shall be tested and the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 3.0 mrad.
condition: if ∆r of the first lamp of sample A exceeds 3.0 mrad but not 4.0 mrad

text: If the value of 3.0 mrad on sample A is not complied with, the two front fog lamps of sample B shall be subjected to the same procedure and ∆r for each of them shall not exceed 3.0 mrad.
condition: if sample A does not comply with 3.0 mrad

text: The luminous intensity distribution of the Class F3 front fog lamp shall incorporate a cut-off line that enables the front fog lamp to be adjusted correctly for the photometric measurements and for the aiming on the vehicle.
The characteristics of the cut-off line of the Class F3 front fog lamp shall comply with the requirements of paragraphs 2 to 4 of Annex 9.
For visual adjustment of the Class F3 front fog beam the cut-off line shall provide a horizontal line for vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp extending to 4° either side of the v-v line.
For horizontal adjustment, the cut-off line of the Class F3 front fog lamp shall be so positioned that the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical to the v-v line.

A Class F3 front fog lamp designed for use in pairs or having an asymmetric beam pattern shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant, or otherwise such that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the v-v line.
condition: if designed for use in pairs or with asymmetric beam pattern

text: After horizontal adjustment, the vertical adjustment of the Class F3 front fog beam shall be performed such that the cut-off line is moved upwards from the lower position until it is situated on the v-v line at 1° below the h-h line.

If the horizontal part of the cut-off line is not straight but slightly curved or inclined, the cut-off line shall not exceed the vertical range formed by two horizontal lines situated between 3° left and right of the v-v line at 0.2° above and below the nominal position of the cut-off.
condition: if the horizontal part is slightly curved or inclined

text: When the vertical positions of three attempts to adjust the cut-off differ by more than 0.2°, the quality of cut-off of the Class F3 front fog lamp shall be tested instrumentally for compliance with the requirements of paragraph 4 of Annex 9.
condition: if three visual adjustment attempts differ by more than 0.2°

text: Cut-off quality measurements shall be performed by vertically scanning upwards through the horizontal part of the cut-off line in angular steps not exceeding 0.05°, along the vertical lines at -2.5° and +2.5° from the v-v line, either at 10 m with a detector of approximately 10 mm diameter or at 25 m with a detector of approximately 30 mm diameter.
condition: when cut-off quality is measured instrumentally

text: The cut-off quality measurement shall be considered acceptable if the requirements of paragraphs 4.1.1 to 4.1.3 of Annex 9 are met with at least one measurement at 10 m or 25 m.
condition: when cut-off quality is measured instrumentally

text: The measuring distance at which the cut-off quality test was determined shall be recorded in the communication form.
condition: when cut-off quality is measured instrumentally

text: Not more than one cut-off line of the Class F3 front fog lamp shall be visible.
condition: when cut-off quality is measured instrumentally

text: If scanned vertically through the horizontal part of the cut-off line along vertical lines at ±1° from the v-v line, the maximum value measured for the sharpness factor G = (log EV - log E(V + 0.1°)) of the cut-off line shall not be less than 0.08.
condition: when cut-off quality is measured instrumentally

text: The part of the cut-off line which serves vertical adjustment shall be horizontal from 3° left to 3° right of the v-v line; this is satisfied if the vertical positions of the inflection points at 3° left and right of the v-v line do not deviate by more than ±0.20°.
condition: when cut-off quality is measured instrumentally

text: Instrumental vertical beam adjustment may be performed only if the cut-off line complies with the quality requirements of paragraph 4 of Annex 9; the inflection point where d2(log E)/dv2 = 0 is positioned on the v-v line below the h-h line.
condition: if instrumental vertical adjustment is used

text: The movement for measuring and adjusting the cut-off line shall be upwards from below the nominal position.
condition: if instrumental vertical adjustment is used

text: In the test for stability of photometric performance of grouped headlamps and front fog lamps, the operational periods shall follow the overview of Annex 10, where the marked functions are subjected to a cycle of 15 minutes off and 5 minutes lit according to the combination (P, D, F) and marking symbols.
condition: if the front fog lamp is grouped or reciprocally incorporated with headlamp functions

text: The optional mark of the centre of reference, if provided, shall be positioned on the lens at its intersection with the reference axis of the front fog lamp.
condition: if a centre of reference mark is provided

text: The centre of reference mark shall have a diameter a of 2 mm minimum; its lines may be solid or dotted.
condition: if a centre of reference mark is provided

text: Each LED module sample submitted shall conform to the relevant specifications of this Regulation when tested with the electronic light source control-gear(s) supplied, if any.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: LED modules shall be so designed as to be, and to remain, in good working order when in normal use.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: LED modules shall exhibit no fault in design or manufacture.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: LED modules shall be tamperproof.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: The design of removable LED modules shall be such that after removal and replacement of the module the photometric requirements of the lamp are still met.
condition: if LED modules are removable

text: The design of removable LED modules shall be such that non-identical LED modules within the same lamp housing cannot be interchanged.
condition: if LED modules are removable

text: The geometric position and dimensions of the elements for optical radiation and shielding, if any, of LED modules shall be as indicated on the submitted data sheet.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: The measurement of the geometric position and dimensions of LED module elements shall be made using optical methods through the transparent envelope, after ageing with the light source supplied by the electronic light source control-gear at test voltage.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: The position, dimension and transmission of the stripes or shields, if any, of LED modules shall be as indicated on the submitted data sheet.
condition: if LED modules with stripes or shields are used

text: The transparent envelope (e.g. bulb) of the light source shall exhibit no marks or spots which might impair its efficiency and optical performance.
The LED(s) on the LED module shall be equipped with suitable fixation elements.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: The fixation elements of the LED(s) shall be strong and firmly secured to the light source(s) and the LED module.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: All LED module samples shall be tested as specified in paragraph 4 of Annex 12.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: The type of light sources shall be as defined in Regulation No. 48 paragraph 2.7.1., in particular with regard to the element of visible radiation; other types of light sources are not permitted.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: All LED module samples shall be tested under the conditions specified in paragraph 6.4.1.4. of this Regulation.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: If not specified differently in Annex 12, LED modules shall be tested inside the front fog lamp as submitted by the manufacturer.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: For the measurement of electrical and photometric characteristics, the front fog lamp shall be operated in dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: LED modules shall be aged before testing.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: The tests of Annex 12 shall be carried out after ageing with the LED module(s) supplied by the submitted electronic light source control-gear at test voltage.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: Upon request of the applicant, the LED module shall be operated for 15 h and cooled down to ambient temperature before starting the tests.
condition: upon request of the applicant

text: Filament lamps shall first be aged at their test voltage for approximately one hour; for dual-filament lamps, each filament shall be aged separately.

With the exception of the starting test, all tests shall be carried out with gas discharge light sources aged for a minimum of 15 cycles of 45 minutes on, 15 seconds off, 5 minutes on, 10 minutes off.

The starting test shall be applied to gas discharge light sources which have not been aged and have not been used for at least 24 hours prior to the test; the light source shall start directly and remain alight.
condition: unless approved according to Regulation No. 99

text: The run-up test shall be applied to gas discharge light sources not used for at least 1 hour prior to the test; the front fog lamp shall reach in the point 0°, 2.5°D on line 6 a luminous intensity of at least 25 per cent of its objective luminous flux after 1 second.
condition: unless approved according to Regulation No. 99

text: In the run-up test, the front fog lamp with gas discharge light source shall reach in the point 0°, 2.5°D on line 6 a luminous intensity of at least 80 per cent of its objective luminous flux after 4 seconds.
condition: unless approved according to Regulation No. 99

text: For the hot re-strike test, the gas discharge light source shall be operated with the electronic light source control-gear at test voltage for 15 minutes, then the supply voltage switched off for 10 seconds and switched on again.
The gas discharge light source shall restart directly after being switched off for 10 seconds.
One second after hot re-strike, the gas discharge light source shall emit at least 80 per cent of its objective luminous flux.
The light of a LED module shall meet the specified minimum red content, calculated using intervals of one nanometre, in addition to the colour measurements of paragraph 7.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: The UV-radiation of the LED module shall meet the specified limit, calculated using intervals of one nanometre and weighted according to the spectral weighting function S(λ) of the UV table, with km = 683 lm/W.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: For the temperature stability test of LED modules, a photometric measurement shall be made after 1 minute of operation with the device at room temperature at the test point horizontal 0°, vertical 2.5°D.
condition: if LED modules are used (filament and gas discharge light sources exempted)

text: The lamp shall continue operation until photometric stability has occurred (variation of the photometric value less than 3 per cent within any 15-minute period); then aiming and complete photometry at all test points shall be performed.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: The ratio between the photometric test point values measured after 1 minute and those measured once photometric stability has been achieved shall be calculated.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: The calculated ratio shall be applied to each of the remaining test points to create a new photometric table describing the complete photometry based on 1 minute of operation.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: The illuminance values measured after one minute and until photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
condition: if LED modules are used

text: The colour of the light emitted, measured after 1 minute and after photometric stability has been obtained, shall be within the required colour boundaries in both instances.
condition: if LED modules are used
